sentences.text: Ten years of war couldn't break one wall.
So one guy weaponized FOMO.
Troy's walls were so strong, Greek spears bounced right off.
So Odysseus drew a plan.
A giant wooden horse.
Hollow.
His best soldiers hid inside, and the whole army sailed away.
Well, they pretended to.
They hid behind an island.
They left one guy behind on the beach.
Sinon.
Tied up.
On purpose.
The Trojans found him, and he started crying.
That horse is a gift for the goddess Athena, he sobbed.
They built it huge, so you could never get it into your city.
Because if it gets inside, Troy can never fall.
The Trojans could not resist stealing the Greeks' luck.
So they tore open their own unbreakable wall, to squeeze it in.
That night, the Greeks climbed out, and opened the gates.
Ten years of attacks failed.
Reverse psychology and a wooden toy didn't.
